## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Reference the approved milestone.

## Verification

Record meaningful build/test results and any limitations. Include screenshots for visible changes when useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Targets this project's `main` branch and stays within the approved milestone.
- [ ] Preserves existing simulation, networking, licenses and asset attribution.
- [ ] Includes relevant verification and documentation updates.
- [ ] Contains no secrets, runtime databases, logs or generated build artifacts.
